## Checklist

- [ ] I created this design myself, and it isn't based on anyone else's design.
- [ ] I dedicate it to the public domain under CC0 1.0, and understand this can't be withdrawn.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), agreeing to the creator certificate in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] `design.yml` lists the devices or battery platforms it fits.
- [ ] It includes at least one photo or render of a real print.
- [ ] Battery adapters: `safety:` is filled in.
